Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Add a CSV import for vendor credits in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; finance needs it this week. SQLAlchemy upgrade is on hold.

Covering index on `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` doubled ingest write latency.

- Next command: not yet specified.

Optimized `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py`, reducing tenant-73 SQL queries from 2,417 to 37 while preserving 14,802 aggregates. Last command: `pytest -q tests/reports/test_invoice_summary.py -W error`; exact result: `18 passed` in 3.72s, no warnings.
